disposition_reason: Table 1 prints concentrations of ten elements in seven local and four imported vegetable groups from the Erbil market.

study.design: Market survey of local and imported vegetables with health risk indices
study.origin: Local (Erbil region) and imported (origin countries not stated)
study.market: Largest vegetable market in Erbil, Kurdistan Region, Iraq
study.method: H2O2/H2SO4 wet digestion of 0.5 g dried sample; ICP-OES (Shimadzu ICPE-9820)
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or blank data reported
